paper.title: Initiation of slime mold aggregation viewed as an instability

headline: Keller-Segel 1970 chemotaxis (grid PDE): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; super-critical S=5.0 peak=869x CV grows 2406x (low-q grows 5/5) vs sub-critical S=0.3 peak=1.00x uniform (low-q grows 0/5)

verdicts.gate: P1 aggregation at S>=3: mean max(rho)/rho0 >= 3.0 AND mean std/mean grows >= 5x
P2 uniform at S<=0.5: mean max(rho)/rho0 <= 1.5 AND std/mean does not grow (<= 1x)
P3 long-wavelength instability sign: low-q mode grows early at S>=3, not at S<=0.5

extra.framing: two-field chemotaxis PDE on a periodic grid (CA), not agent-stepping
extra.numerics: conservative upwind chemotactic flux (mass-conserving, non-negative); explicit Euler with dt within the CFL limit (peak CFL recorded); a numerical blow-up would be reported, not scored as aggregation
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Keller-Segel chemotactic-collapse instability threshold (aggregation above a sensitivity threshold, uniform below, long-wavelength mode) and would catch an artifact

citations: Keller, E.F. & Segel, L.A. (1970). Initiation of slime mold aggregation viewed as an instability. Journal of Theoretical Biology 26(3):399-415. doi:10.1016/0022-5193(70)90092-5.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Keller-Segel aggregation threshold (peak ratio, CV growth, long-wavelength mode sign)
